content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Apprentice Trainee in Pharmacy Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST) based in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, for filling up designated apprentice positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post offered in this notification?
faq.answer: The post offered in this official notification is Apprentice Trainee in Pharmacy under the health and medical research sector of the institution.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Apprentice Trainee in Pharmacy position in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for SCTIMST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application and selection is strictly through a Walk-in Interview process where eligible candidates report directly to the designated venue.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification for the post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a D. Pharm qualification, while having knowledge in computer applications is considered a desirable asset for the applicants.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for this apprentice trainee post is 30 years as specified in the recruitment rules.

faq.question: Q7. How much salary or stipend will be provided?
faq.answer: Selected candidates appointed as Apprentice Trainee in Pharmacy will receive a consolidated monthly stipend amounting to Rs. 10900 Per Month.

faq.question: Q8. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is officially scheduled to take place on 12-10-2026 at the specified venue and reporting time given in the notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category including General, OBC, SC, and ST candidates participating in this walk-in selection.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of the institute?
faq.answer: You can check all official updates, circulars, and detailed notifications by visiting the official website of the institute at www.sctimst.ac.in.
